title: Stateful Large Language Model Serving with Pensieve
authors: Lingfan Yu; Jinkun Lin; Jinyang Li
venue_full: Twentieth European Conference on Computer Systems (EuroSys '25)
research_focus: LLM serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Continuous batching

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems are stateless across requests: in multi-turn conversations the growing dialogue history is re-prefetched and recomputed with every request, so prefill cost of redundant history processing soon outgrows generation cost.
problem_statement.zh: 既有 LLM 服務系統在請求之間為 stateless：多輪對話中不斷成長的歷史必須隨每個請求重新作為 prompt 處理，重複的 prefill 計算成本很快超過 generation 本身。

key_innovation.en: Stateful serving with a two-tier GPU-CPU KV cache for conversation state: chunk-granularity (32-token) eviction ranked by retention value V = recompute-cost / inactive-time (preferring to evict leading tokens, which are cheaper to recompute), ahead-of-time swap-out with pipelined layer-by-layer swap-in, recomputation for dropped tokens, and a new multi-token attention kernel (generalized PagedAttention) that runs prefill over non-contiguous KV cache and unifies prefill and generation batching.
key_innovation.zh: 以雙層 GPU-CPU KV cache 保存對話狀態的 stateful serving：以 32-token chunk 為粒度、依 retention value V =（重算成本 / 閒置時間）排序逐出（偏好逐出重算較便宜的開頭 token），ahead-of-time 換出搭配逐層 pipeline 換入，被丟棄的 token 以重算補回；並提出新的 multi-token attention kernel（廣義化 PagedAttention），使 prefill 可直接在非連續 KV cache 上執行，進而統一 prefill 與 generation 的批次排程。

key_improvements.en: 1.14-3.0x throughput of vLLM and TensorRT-LLM: 1.36x/1.14x (OPT-13B, ShareGPT) and 1.70x/1.58x (Llama 2-13B) on one GPU; 2.04x/1.64x (OPT-66B) and 3.0x/2.47x (Llama 2-70B) on four GPUs; recompute-aware eviction beats LRU by up to 4.4 pp CPU-cache hit rate, cutting recomputed KV-tokens by up to 14.6%.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量為 vLLM 與 TensorRT-LLM 的 1.14-3.0x：單 GPU 上 OPT-13B（ShareGPT）為 1.36x/1.14x、Llama 2-13B 為 1.70x/1.58x；四 GPU 上 OPT-66B 為 2.04x/1.64x、Llama 2-70B 為 3.0x/2.47x；重算成本感知的逐出策略較 LRU 提升最多 4.4 個百分點的 CPU cache 命中率，重算 KV-token 數最多減少 14.6%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
